StagedUnmtchdEmailAddrRela.name: StagedUnmtchdEmailAddrRela
StagedUnmtchdEmailAddrRela.description: Represents data about the message or event activity associated with an email address that Einstein Activity Capture can’t match with an existing user, contact, or lead record. Related to StagedUnmtchdEmailAddr, which represents data about the unmatched email address.

RelatedActivityId.description: The unique ID of the related activity record, such as an email message or calendar event.

SourceActivity.description: The activity type. Possible values are: Event StagedEmail EmailAddress

StagedUnmatchedEmailAddressId.description: The unique ID of the related unmatched email address record.
